scope: Multiplayer core Mounting Defense + Local Alliances
scenario: Only an active local alliance of strength2 is available to meet a strength1 attack. Does exhaustion defend successfully, and how is excess strength counted?

source_passages.rule: Alliance strength usable for Deploy/defense once, cannot split among more than one purpose.
Exhaust pieces equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible; if newly exhausted pieces do not equal it, Crisis succeeds.
